You are acting as the `requirements-analyst` subagent executing the `spec-intake` skill for `/v0-intake p2-k-integration-governance-execution-freeze-archive`.

### Important Workspace Rules

  `bash /home/e2e/kit-src/refs/e2e-test-plan/scripts/agy-ws-exec.sh --test-root /home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629 '<command>'`

- Never edit `docs/agents-v0/lessons.md`.

### Source Specification (`docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md`)
- **Milestone**: `P2 — MVP / Core Features`
- **Milestone file**: `docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md`
- **Story ID**: `P2-K`
- **Feature artifact**: `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-k-integration-governance-execution-freeze-archive.md`
- **Surface**: `backend`
- **Size**: `7` (`AC-1` through `AC-7`)
- **Dependency**: `P2-G, P2-H`
- **User story (copy verbatim from milestone row)**:
  `As a finance approver, I want governance ticket approvals to enforce the runtime execution freeze via ExecutionFreezePort by rejecting configuration cutovers with HTTP 409 when targeted definitions have JOB_QUEUED or RUNNING runs, and to execute atomic S3 archival and log-only SAP connector handoff via ExecutionArchivePort on SAP_REPORT_POSTING approval while keeping SUCCESS runs valid on ticket rejection or cancellation, so that in-flight runs are never corrupted and ledger postings are 100% ticket-governed.`
- **Cross-context integration coverage (`context-map.md`)**:
  `P2-K`: `governance` <-> `execution` (`ExecutionFreezePort` `hasInFlightRuns` lock & `ExecutionArchivePort` S3 archive + SAP log connector).
- **Security review triggers (`p2-mvp-core-features.md`)**:
  `P2-H`, `P2-K`, `P2-L`, `P2-S`: New attachment upload endpoint (`POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/attachments`) and `{id}` ticket decision routes (`security-baseline.mdc` §5, VAPT F4/F8/F10). Specifically for `P2-K`, `{id}` ticket decision routes (`POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/approve`, `POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/reject`, `POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/cancel`, and `POST /api/v1/runs/{id}/approve-sap`), `RBAC`, and `auth`.

### Accepted Cross-Story Lessons (`docs/agents-v0/lessons.md`)
- `L-002`: Name PostgreSQL-backed integration tests `*Test.java` unless Maven Failsafe is explicitly wired in `pom.xml`.
- `L-003`: Define dedicated port value types (`StoredObjectMetadata` in `com.example.app.execution.port`) on cross-context ports rather than returning internal domain entities.
- `L-004` / `L-005`: Annotate refusal-auditing service methods (`EXECUTION_FREEZE_REFUSED` / `SOD_CONFLICT_REFUSED` / `AUTHZ_DENIED` / `VIEW_AS_MUTATION_BLOCKED`) with `@Transactional(noRollbackFor = ContractProblemException.class)` and use 2-argument `Objects.requireNonNull(dep, "dep must not be null")` in constructors.
- `L-008`: Expose package-private `jdbcTemplate()` accessor on `@Repository` classes when copying `JdbcTemplate` references in copy constructors.

### Codebase & Architecture Mapping (Already Verified)
- `ExecutionFreezePort` (`com.example.app.execution.port.ExecutionFreezePort`) and `ReportRunFreezeService` (`com.example.app.execution.service.ReportRunFreezeService`) expose `boolean hasInFlightRuns(UUID reportDefinitionId)` (and can also lock/check or resolve affected definitions for reference tables/recipes/schedules).
- `ExecutionArchivePort` (`com.example.app.execution.port.ExecutionArchivePort`) implemented by `RunArtifactStorageService` exposes `StoredObjectMetadata archiveApprovedRunDraft(UUID reportRunId, UUID ticketId, String ticketNumber, String desiredArchiveObjectKey, String correlationId)`, which copies the run's `DRAFT_SAP_CSV` from the S3 `artifacts` bucket to the immutable `archive` bucket with collision-safe `_v2` and `_<epoch_ms>` naming, persists an `ARCHIVED_CSV` row in `run_artifacts`, emits `SapPostingArchiveEvent` (`SAP_REPORT_POSTING_ARCHIVED`) via `SapArchivalConnectorPort` (`LogOnlySapConnector`), and executes compensating `objectStoragePort.deleteObject` if DB persistence fails.
- In `GovernanceTicketWorkflowService.approveTicket` (`POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/approve`):
  1. For configuration lifecycle ticket types (`REPORT_DEFINITION_CREATE`, `REPORT_DEFINITION_CHANGE`, `RECIPE_VERSION_PUBLISH`, `REFERENCE_TABLE_CREATE`, `REFERENCE_TABLE_CHANGE`, `SCHEDULE_CHANGE`), `approveTicket` must enforce the Runtime Execution Freeze via `ExecutionFreezePort` (inspecting `target_definition_id`, or for reference table tickets any active report definition whose active recipe references that reference lookup table, or locking the targeted `report_definitions` row via `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` and checking `hasInFlightRuns`). When any targeted report definition has an active run in `JOB_QUEUED` or `RUNNING` status, `POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/approve` must refuse the approval with `HTTP 409 Conflict` (`application/problem+json`, `errorCode = "EXECUTION_FREEZE_ACTIVE"`, `correlationId`), keep the ticket in `PENDING_APPROVAL` at its existing `version`, and record a refusal audit entry (`EXECUTION_FREEZE_REFUSED` / `DENIED_EXECUTION_FREEZE`) in `audit_log_entries` via `AuditEventPort` using `@Transactional(noRollbackFor = ContractProblemException.class)` (`L-004`).
  2. When zero in-flight runs exist for the targeted definition(s), configuration ticket approval succeeds with `HTTP 200 OK` (`status = "APPROVED"`, updated `ETag`, `GOVERNANCE_TICKET_APPROVED` audit log).
  3. For `SAP_REPORT_POSTING` tickets approved via `POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/approve` (as well as `POST /api/v1/runs/{id}/approve-sap`), the approval workflow must verify the target `report_runs` row is in `status = "SUCCESS"` with a persisted `DRAFT_SAP_CSV` artifact, invoke `ExecutionArchivePort.archiveApprovedRunDraft(...)` within the approval transaction to copy `DRAFT_SAP_CSV` from the S3 `artifacts` bucket to the `archive` bucket (`archive/<definitionCode>/<reportPeriod>/sap-<definitionCode>-<reportPeriod>.csv`, resolving collisions with `_v2` and `_<epoch_ms>` suffixes), insert the `ARCHIVED_CSV` row in `run_artifacts`, emit the structured `SAP_REPORT_POSTING_ARCHIVED` event via `SapArchivalConnectorPort` (`LogOnlySapConnector`), increment `report_runs.version`, transition the `SAP_REPORT_POSTING` ticket to `APPROVED` (`version = version + 1`), and record `GOVERNANCE_TICKET_APPROVED` (and `EXECUTION_RUN_SAP_APPROVED`) in `audit_log_entries`. If S3 archival, `run_artifacts` persistence, or `SapArchivalConnectorPort` fails, compensating S3 cleanup removes any newly copied archive object and the PostgreSQL transaction rolls back so the ticket remains `PENDING_APPROVAL`.
  4.
